preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.

invariants.description: The number of edges must remain equal to m throughout the game.

invariants.expression: all(degree(v) <= 3 for v in range(1, n + 1))
invariants.description: The degree of any vertex must not exceed 3.
There must be a cycle of length not greater than 5 passing through each edge.
